facebookresearch_parlai/parlai/tasks/ent.extract_entailment_steps: extract reasoning steps from a full text proof string using _get_steps to split on BECAUSE AND INFER tokens
facebookresearch_parlai/parlai/tasks/ent.configure_task_id: configure the teacher with --task-id 1 2 or 3 to select which entailment task dataset to use
facebookresearch_parlai/parlai/tasks/ent.enable_extrinsic_step: enable extrinsic step mode with --extrinsic-step to inject a random step from another example into each data point
